# NOTICE OF REQUEST FOR EVIDENCE

> FICTIONAL SAMPLE — created for the SuperDocs engineering task.

Receipt number: WAC-26-101-77821 (fictional)

The following evidence must be submitted by the response deadline.

Request 1: The record lacks a legible copy of the beneficiary's degree
certificate and transcripts. Provide these together with a credential

Request 2: Establish that the offered position is a specialty occupation by
describing the actual day-to-day duties, the percentage of time allocated
